quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 3.86 billion, up 19.67% from RMB 3.22 billion; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 447.11 million, down 7.98%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 433.59 million, down 6.21%; operating cash flow RMB 626.40 million, down 21.43%. Q2 2026 revenue RMB 21.74 hundred million, up 23.26% YoY and 29.02% QoQ, a record quarter (board letter); Q2 net profit attributable RMB 2.69 hundred million, up 6.53% YoY and 51.35% QoQ. Q1 2026 revenue RMB 168,482.25 ten-thousand. Quarterly gross margin: Q1 2026 32.53%, Q2 2026 34.41% (down 2.37 YoY, up 1.88 QoQ); H1 gross margin 33.59% (down 3.09); H1 gross profit RMB 12.96 hundred million (+9.58%). The company said metal raw-material purchase prices have risen sharply since H2 2025, so H1 revenue grew without profit growth.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue by application (half-year report, RMB ten-thousand): signal processing 140,082 (+20.46%); power management 128,202 (+11.50%); automotive electronics or energy-storage dedicated components 88,124 (+37.40%); ceramics, PCB and other 29,441 (+8.96%); total 385,850 (+19.67%). The board letter says automotive-electronics sales grew more than 30% YoY despite slower domestic auto growth, energy-storage revenue rose significantly on a fast downstream recovery, consumer electronics grew steadily in Q2 though end demand was weak on memory-chip price increases, and data center kept growing strongly. By region: domestic sales RMB 3.36 billion (87.06% of revenue, +23.75%, gross margin 33.74%), export sales RMB 499.29 million (12.94%, -2.05%, gross margin 32.58%).

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board letter (half-year report): the company started its AI-inductor work in 2019; orders for core products such as AI inductors and TLVR inductors are now expanding rapidly; the new-structure tantalum capacitors are gradually gaining customer qualification; ceramic substrates and ceramic packages for optical communications are poised to launch. The board said the AI track has become an important pillar and expects related revenue to expand rapidly this year.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Costs and pricing (half-year report): the company said it is using earlier inventory to ease cost pressure and negotiating with customers to share further cost increases, and Q2 margin recovery shows early results; precious-metal prices, its core cost item, show signs of falling back but remain far above last year's level, and internal improvement alone cannot fully absorb the material-cost rise. Risk section: memory-price increases make downstream communications and consumer-electronics customers' shipment expectations for this year rather pessimistic; competition in data center and AI+ markets is intensifying and may weigh on its product prices there; it is speeding up construction of overseas plants. Financial expenses rose 57.90% on larger exchange losses.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New HTCC product line (half-year report): the company lists high-temperature co-fired ceramic (HTCC) substrates and ceramic packages as a product series - aluminium nitride and alumina multilayer ceramic substrates, hermetic ceramic packages and laser packages - and says HTCC suits the packaging of optical chips, lasers, silicon-photonics engines and high-frequency microwave devices, especially 800G/1.6T optical modules and CPO co-packaged optical engines. It said it has laid out aluminium nitride ceramic substrate and HTCC ceramic package businesses ahead of demand, forming complete precision-ceramic support for optical-module chip packaging and optical-engine high-density wiring and heat dissipation; the products also serve new energy, robotics, low-altitude economy, medical and security uses.
